questions.statement: I play ________ with a black and white ball.
questions.context: Learning about sports in English class.

options.feedback: Correct. A football is traditionally a black and white ball, and it is played with the feet on a field.
A basketball is orange, not black and white.
A tennis ball is yellow-green, not black and white.
A golf ball is white and is hit with a club on a green, not with the foot.

Baseball is played with a bat on a diamond and there is no basket.
